limitations: The v0.9 controller is track-trained analytical ML, not a pretrained neural waveform model.

Stereo Event Repair, Low-End Intelligence and Stereo Vocal Focus are bounded inferences from the authoritative stereo mix; each requires a separate measured promotion gate.
